==English==

===Etymology===
{{surf|en|fast|-ing}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfæstɪŋ/|a=GA}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfɑːstɪŋ/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Sapaa-fasting.wav|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|æstɪŋ|ɑːstɪŋ|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{head|en|verb form}}

# {{infl of|en|fast||ing-form}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# [[abstinence|Abstinence]] or [[mortification]] for religious reasons, especially abstinence from [[food]].
#* {{RQ:Landon Francesca Carrara|pages=269–270|volume=III|text=Long vigils—'''fastings''' that wore away the strength of day—prayers that banished sleep from night—hoarded vengeance, that, like a fire, consumed its abode—affections crushed to the very earth—a memory whose love was with the grave,—a faith that had coloured itself with mortal passion,—all these had pressed too heavily on the springs of life and thought;...}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1904|author=w:H. G. Wells|title=The Food of the Gods and How It Came to Earth
|passage=Immediately after that affair Lady Wondershoot, casting about for exemplary additions to the abuse and '''fastings''' she had inflicted, issued a Ukase. She issued it first to her butler, and very suddenly, so that she made him jump.}}
# Abstinence from [[food]], [[limit]]ing [[caloric]] [[intake]], for [[medical]] or [[health]] [[reason]]s, [[dieting]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|journal=United States Navy Medical News Letter|volume=50|issue=10|date=17 November 1967|page=13
|passage=an obese patient while he was undergoing '''fasting''' for weight reduction}}

====Derived terms====
{{col|en|nonfasting|prefasting|unfasting|fasting glucose|fasting spittle|skin fasting|fasting blood sugar}}
